name: Cabo Verde

findings.local_actor: Government of Cabo Verde / National Police
findings.financier: Unspecified Chinese government institution (financing unclear per AidData)
findings.summary: Cidade Segura phase 1: Huawei built a police command centre in Achada Grande Frente and a 300-camera urban surveillance system with intelligent alerts and 112 emergency number in Praia, operating 24 hours since July 2018.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole prc: Huawei is the equipment vendor and installer. US$4.5m phase-1 cost is AidData's figure; AidData notes financing is unclear and may be co-funded by Cabo Verde government and Huawei. Lusa (2019) confirms operation a year after launch; current status in 2026 not confirmed.

findings.local_actor: Government of Cabo Verde / National Police
findings.builder: Huawei Technologies (contractor); Eleven Technology and Sichuan Huakai Project Management (management unit)
findings.summary: Cidade Segura phase 2, a Chinese government grant with Huawei as contractor, extended pole-mounted surveillance cameras to Mindelo, Sal, Boa Vista and more of Praia (250 poles) plus a police LTE network; reported completed June 2021.

sources.publisher: Macao Trade and Investment Promotion Institute (IPIM)

findings.analyst_inference: Completion date relies on AidData citing Eleven Technology; Lusa 2019 only confirms phase 2 was planned for São Vicente, Sal and Boa Vista. AidData's 2018 note on phase 1 cites an RMB 92.5m grant for phase 2; not converted, value left null. Scale national because it spans four islands. IPIM (Macao SAR government) not opened.

findings.summary: The same Cidade Segura phase 2 package included a 4G (LTE) private network for police communications, delivered by Huawei.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor Huawei, so prc. Tier 4 not 5: AidData reports the phase complete but does not describe the LTE network's operational use. Single opened source.

findings.financier: European Investment Bank (Cabo Verde segment); EU BELLA programme (system)
findings.summary: The EllaLink Europe–Brazil cable, built by Alcatel Submarine Networks, went live in Cabo Verde in June 2022 via a Cabo Verde Telecom landing station in Praia, with EIB support.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third: equipment vendor ASN is French (Nokia subsidiary at build time). Values conflict (DCD: CVT to invest US$25m; Ecofin: US$60m total with EIB US$25m), so left null. Supplier named only in the 2018 SubTel Forum piece.

findings.summary: The AfDB-financed Cabo Verde Technology Park in Praia, with a data centre and a São Vicente disaster-recovery site, began operating in 2023 and was officially launched in May 2025; a second Praia data centre is planned.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole domestic assumed: government-launched public-private park, but no source names the owner-operator, builder or IT-equipment vendor. Tier 5 applies to the park and existing data centre; the second data centre is only planned. US$58.78m is Developing Telecoms' conversion of EUR 51.85m total park cost.

findings.local_actor: Secretary of State for Digital Economy, Cabo Verde
findings.summary: A Microsoft–Cabo Verde strategic agreement under the Digital Development Program provides Microsoft 365 for schools, Azure-based tools and Copilot AI for public administration, and startup access to AI tools including OpenAI GPT-4.

sources.publisher: Microsoft / Government of Cabo Verde joint press release (Web Summit)

findings.analyst_inference: Tier 2 as a framework agreement; no value or binding procurement shown. Signed 2023 at the UN General Assembly (likely September). Coded models because Copilot/GPT-4 via Microsoft's service is US-controlled; overlaps cloud layer. Single S4 corporate release. Deployment scale of Copilot unknown.

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchases surfaced in data-centre, Huawei or AI searches

power.null_reason: no AI- or data-centre-specific power evidence surfaced

research_gaps: Radio/core vendors for CV Telecom (Alou) and Unitel T+ mobile networks not established; one search named none.
Who supplied IT equipment for the TechPark CV data centre and who owns/operates it under the PPP; who is contracted for the second Praia data centre and São Vicente DR site?
Is the Huawei Cidade Segura system (phases 1 and 2) still operating in 2026, and was phase-2 completion independently confirmed?

NOSi–Huawei partnership (Jan 2024 meeting) and government–Huawei meeting (July 2026) mention unnamed 'nationally relevant projects'; identify any signed contracts (e.g. government data centre or network).
Did the Microsoft Copilot deployment in public administration go beyond pilot scale?
